findings.highlight: I say yesterday’s park
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の公園、ぐらいかな
findings.governingReading: perhaps yesterday’s park
findings.explanation: A tentative suggestion becomes malformed assertive English.

findings.highlight: They say the criminal returns to the scene of the crime
findings.evidenceJa: 犯罪者は現場に戻るって言うし、もしかしたら
findings.governingReading: they say a criminal returns to the scene, so perhaps the shadow might as well
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops the unfinished possibility linking the proverb to Shirou’s proposed search.

findings.highlight: find the shadow there
findings.evidenceJa: 幸運にもあの影と遭遇したとして
findings.governingReading: even if they are fortunate enough to encounter the shadow
findings.explanation: Saber’s general hypothetical encounter is fixed at the park.

findings.highlight: we shouldn’t be trying to find the shadow right now
findings.evidenceJa: あの影と偶然遭える事を期待するのではなく、あの影は何者で何処から来るのかを調べるべきだ
findings.governingReading: they should investigate what the shadow is and where it comes from instead of hoping to encounter it by chance
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns a rejection of chance-based searching into a rejection of finding the shadow at all, contradicting the investigation that follows.

findings.highlight: I noticed that Caster was acting strange
findings.evidenceJa: 今にして思うと、キャスターの様子はどこかヘンだった
findings.governingReading: thinking back now, Caster seemed strange somehow at the time
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: a retrospective impression becomes something Shirou consciously noticed during the encounter.

findings.highlight: I think there’s something there
findings.evidenceJa: あそこにはまだ何かある気がする
findings.governingReading: he feels there is still something at the temple
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: the sense that something remains after Caster’s disappearance loses its temporal relation.

findings.highlight: The land there is the spiritual focus of this town
findings.evidenceJa: 最も霊的な手が加えられているのはあの土地
findings.governingReading: that land has undergone more spiritual intervention than any other place in town
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: a claim about deliberate spiritual modification becomes an intrinsic spiritual focal point.

findings.highlight: worth investigating, regardless of whether the shadow is there
findings.evidenceJa: あの影とは別に、一度調べてみる価値はある
findings.governingReading: worth investigating once as a matter separate from the shadow
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: mirror Moon keeps the shadow tied to the temple as a possible location instead of separating the two investigations.

findings.highlight: We walk to the gate
findings.evidenceJa: 中庭から門へ向かう
findings.governingReading: they head from the courtyard toward the gate
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: the scene’s courtyard starting point disappears.

findings.highlight: We don’t have any time to lose
findings.evidenceJa: 行くのなら早い方がいい
findings.governingReading: if they are going, the sooner they leave the better
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: a practical preference for leaving early becomes categorical urgency.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s room, where Sakura should now be sleeping
findings.evidenceJa: もう眠りについた桜の部屋
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s room, where she has already gone to sleep
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: an observed or narrated completed state becomes Shirou’s uncertain expectation.

findings.highlight: her sins
findings.evidenceJa: 犯してしまった間違い
findings.governingReading: mistakes she has committed
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: mirror Moon moralizes Sakura’s errors into sins.

findings.highlight: She brands herself with her dishonor, rather than working to recover her honor
findings.evidenceJa: 汚名を返上しようとするのではなく、汚名を刻み付けようとしてしまう
findings.governingReading: instead of clearing the stain on her name, she engraves that stain into herself
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: the reversible stain-versus-engraving metaphor becomes an abstract honor-code contrast.

findings.highlight: She talks with disgust
findings.evidenceJa: 苦々しく語る
findings.governingReading: Saber speaks bitterly
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: bitterness directed partly toward Saber herself becomes disgust.

findings.highlight: She is special when she is with you
findings.evidenceJa: シロウと共にいる時の彼女が特別
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s state when she is with Shirou is the exceptional one
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: the exception in Sakura’s behavior becomes a vague claim that Sakura herself is special.

findings.highlight: she behaves differently in other circumstances
findings.evidenceJa: 普段はもっと別のものではないのか
findings.governingReading: her ordinary state may be something substantially different
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: saber’s contrast with Sakura’s usual self becomes behavior under unspecified circumstances.

findings.highlight: live with pride without needing to rely on another
findings.evidenceJa: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れるようにならなければいけない
findings.governingReading: become able to hold her head high even when by herself
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: independent self-respect becomes a judgment that Sakura must not rely on another person.

findings.highlight: I’ll be careful
findings.evidenceJa: 俺も気をつけてみる
findings.governingReading: he will try to pay closer attention to Sakura
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: shirou’s proposed observation and care becomes ambiguous caution about his own conduct.

findings.highlight: go outside to hang out
findings.evidenceJa: 外に遊びに行く
findings.governingReading: go out somewhere for recreation
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: mirror Moon replaces Sakura independently going out to enjoy herself with the socially narrower “hang out.”

findings.highlight: I also have a guilty conscience
findings.evidenceJa: 自責にかられる彼女の気持ちは私にもあったものです
findings.governingReading: Saber once knew the same feelings that drive Sakura to blame herself
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: saber’s recognition of her own past experience becomes a generic present guilty conscience.

findings.highlight: We head to the gate together
findings.evidenceJa: 肩を並べて門へ向かう
findings.governingReading: they head to the gate shoulder to shoulder
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats this error: the equal, side-by-side physical image concluding the exchange is omitted.
